reviews.text: Robyn and her team have been caring for my cats when I travel since 2009.  If they weren't great, I wouldn't stick with them for 17+ years!  I know when I'm away, my fur babies will be well cared for, with lots of snuggles and play time.  Thanks In Home Pet Services, for taking such good care of the "kids".  I couldn't travel without you!

In Home was a life saver for our family! We needed to find a reliable sitting/boarding service for our beloved Chi chi, and it was a completely new process for us. We had concerns with Rover since you are hiring an individual, and luckily came across in home pet services and their website eased a lot of our concerns. There is a lot of love for animals with this company and Robyn is fantastic. We have done boarding a few times, and were nervous if our chi chi will like it. The second drop off, chi chi ran in without even looking back at us. She loves it so much.

I recommend this place to anyone who has pet needs. They are very affordable, and very knowledgeable about animals. The owner is a former zookeeper and pet store manager, so you're in good hands. We can truly relax when on vacations, day trips, etc. knowing our Chi chi is in good hands.

In Home Pet Services took wonderful care of my cat, Charleston,  while I was on vacation.  It was my first time using their services, and I felt at ease the moment I met the team. I am incredibly thankful for the peace of mind while I was on vacation!

When we needed a cat sitter VERY last minute Robyn was there for us! We were able to relax knowing our furry friends were in good hands. Even our extremely shy and skittish cat likes Robyn , she is so kind and professional and left everything  so clean and neat. We’re so luckily to have reliable in home Pet services near us. Highly Recommend.

Best dog walking service Ive had. Due to my job with long hours, they have gone above and beyond being accommodating. They are amazing in communication. All my emails get answered quickly. I have a strong chocolate lab and I feel confident with the walker I have.  Shout out to Ed.

If I could give more than 5+ I would. When we got our puppy, I was so worried leaving her when I worked late. I met Robyn and her team and never worried again. They took such INCREDIBLE care of our Maggie girl on walks. Sometimes I had her puppy camera on because she liked to chew my shoes! The highlight of my day was seeing her so happy, rolling on her back for belly rubs with her amazing walkers: Eddie, Aaliyah, Jaime, Ed, Nataly. I know that she loves them very much because they took such good care of her. Unfortunately we are moving, and I know our girl will miss them. Luckily, she can go to daycare with Robyn and her team :D Thank you everyone!!! Maggie also says thank you for the walks, belly rubs, and treats!!

I have been using this outstanding organization for over 10 years and,  there is no one I trust more to care for my pug with special needs than this kind, flexible hardworking team. The doggy day care and boarding is top notch and the thoroughness and reliability of the walkers is extremely rare.                                          They are very accommodating to specific dietary needs  and environmental sensitivities. Charlie the pug is the happiest pug because of them. We have moved recently and I have gone on vacation and the team has been with Charlie the pug through all the changes and provided loving consistency and reliable communication that makes our lives so much easier when we need the extra support.                                                                       They also have helped to point out things about puggy baby that sometimes I overlook from being tired or busy.                                   The prices are super reasonable  and Charlie the pug gives 2 paws up for her outstanding team that have given her the courage and strength to move to a new home, make new friends and to be the healthiest happiest pug in the milky way galaxy.

In Home Pet Services Forever!

I have been using In Home Pet Services for my dog and now for my cat over several years . They have a wonderful caring staff and very flexible if you need to change your schedule. Have recommended to many of my friends.

We have used “in Home Pet Services,Inc.” couple times now and have only had positive experiences. The service we were seeking were given above and beyond with professionalism and extreme care for our pet. We will continue to use them for our pet care needs in the future.

I used them for years and they always have been there for me.  Just the other day I had to travel on short notice and they were able to take care of my cats for me.  I go away knowing I don’t need to worry about the cats, they’re in good hands.

Incredible team!  Super flexible, reasonably priced (I’ve done the research), dependable and very genuine with both you and your dog! Our dog Blue hates the rain, and is ‘hit or miss’ to go out when it is raining. The team is so accommodating - we can either cancel the morning of due to the weather, or if we play it by ear, and he won’t go out, he gets playtime with extra belly rubs instead!

I couldn’t be happier with In Home Pet Services. Taylor is trustworthy, reliable. I can leave home knowing my bunny Zoey is in very good hands !!
Robyn and her team are flexible when I need to make any changes in the schedule. They operate a great service for pet owners. Don’t hesitate to trust them in your home and with your pets.

Have had such a great experience with my two dogs over the last few years! In Home is extremely accommodating to last minute schedule changes and my dogs are always so happy each day when I come home from work after their walks. Highly recommend!

Honestly, I am so happy I found In Home Pet Services.  Harry loves his daily walks, which are usually with Andrea or Eddie.  When I tell him that he is going to see one of them he starts looking around the room for them.  They are extremely reliable and have very competitive prices.

We have been using this company for over 5 years for three of our dogs. They have amazing availability and they are extremely understanding and flexible with our family’s constantly changing schedule. Our dog Journey got very sick with …

In home pet service came highly recommended by my neighbors. Robyn and Taylor are always quick with their responses. The walkers that we've had are Rianne and Donna. They are puntual, reliable and truly cares for my dog's well-being. I love …
Robyn and team have been really great, flexible, kind and knowledgeable!  So happy to have them jump in when needed!!!

After three days and two nights away, I returned home to my wonderful, happy dogs.  It is great to know I can now have a little vacay without the worry of finding quality, caring dog care.  Thank you In Home!
